blocks.title: Physical-digital twin loop — Industrial IoT & Sensor Fabric
blocks.note: The twin is only as good as its last synchronization; drift is measured on a schedule and flagged rather than trusted.

blocks.x: We engineer Industrial IoT & Sensor Fabric so that regressions are cohorts, not surprises: each stage owns its latency budget and failure policy, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Industrial IoT & Sensor Fabric capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
